inspiration: Build a loading bar from separate slices (left cap, middle, right cap, outline pieces, fill). Our own palette and pixel-art slices would give the same modular look without copying anything.
Keep art in a packed, indexed cache (one index file plus data per group) that the client streams at start-up. This is an architecture idea for our asset pipeline, not a visual to copy.
Name item icons by numeric id in one folder (items/<id>.png). Simple lookup, easy to batch-generate our own icons.
The splash screen comes from a remote URL. For us, ship the splash and loading art locally, with our own look.
This donor has no creature, armour, zone or effect art in the repo, so there is nothing visual to emulate. Its useful lessons are the loading and cache structure only.
Keep the restricted note in mind: study the shape of the loader and cache, never copy constants or code.
